ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_exp_contrastive_delta_regret
ir.intuition: This loss shifts from advantage-based ranking losses to a contrastive paradigm using the exponential of the negative regret difference as a similarity measure. It encourages the model to assign higher probabilities to options with lower regret by minimizing an exponential contrastive loss that emphasizes pairs with large delta_regret gaps, promoting robust preference signals.
ir.pseudocode:
pos_score = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
neg_regret = -delta_regret
scaled_score = pos_score * exp(neg_regret)
loss = mean(weight * softplus(-scaled_score))
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_regret = batch['delta_regret']
    pos_score = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    neg_regret = ops.neg(delta_regret)
    scale = ops.exp(neg_regret)
    scaled_score = ops.mul(pos_score, scale)
    loss = ops.softplus(ops.neg(scaled_score))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
